description: Vaarweg Netwerk Data Service - bevaarbaarheid is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Vaarweg Netwerk Data Service (VNDS) - bevaarbaarheid is de selectie bevaarbaarheid van de vaarwegen uit Fairway Information Services (FIS). In FIS-VNDS is voor iedere haven, vaarweg of een deel daarvan een bevaarbaarheidsklasse toegekend. De indeling voor die klassen is gebaseerd op de afmetingen van standaard-schepen en duwstellen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are HVD, Hoogwaardige dataset - EU, bevaarbaarheid, cemt, navigeren. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
